Intro: Hello dear, I'm looking for something easy to bring back for the girls. I thought I'd treat them for today's hard work.
Life's not easy in the brothel. If we are not perfect for the customer, Svetka's soldiers will be the next ones at our door.
But nothing's worse than the streets. At Repose, at least people have to pay to touch, hm~?
Oh, before I go, can you hold onto this vase of roses for me? It was gifted to me by a customer, but I don't have the hands for this and the food.
Success: Thank you, Dear. I will return soon. All I ask is that you don't mess with the vase! Need to show my customers I care!
Fail: Ah…well, I guess this works. I will return soon. All I ask is that you don't mess with the vase! Need to show my customers I care.
Reject: Point taken. No need to worry about the vase then. I'll be heading out.
